starterRequirement: Five distinct current-roster NBA confirmed starters for the selected team, each confirmation no more than five minutes old. No probability/EV from market presence, depth-chart projection or last-game lineup alone.
distribution: Five competing starter outcomes plus residual probability of a nonstarter scoring the team's first points. Free throws count. Team-first score is independent of which team scores first in the game.
features: Same-team prior starts and starter first-score wins, optionally recent-20 starter history and shrunk G/F/C first-score rates per starting-player exposure. No count-prop correlation filter or historical grade is a probability.
windowReason: No complete five-starter lineup met the 20-prior-same-team-start requirement before December 15. This separate first-team model uses later windows selected for sample availability before examining diagnostic scores; the original prop windows are unchanged.
fitting: Choose shrinkage/recent/positional exponents on development dates only; positive temperature on calibration dates only. Hold entire dates together. Final-box starters in retrospective evaluation define a conditional-known-lineup scenario; historical pregame announcements were not archived.
interpretation: Already inspected archive, unvalidated prior-season transfer, no historical FanDuel prices or historical profitability. Separate model and research cohort; frozen Points/Threes engine, model and forward protocol unchanged.
